svg.title: Figure 11.5 · What the trained heads attend to
svg.desc: Two heatmaps of 20 layers by 16 heads. Left: weight on the previous token; a few heads in layers 3–5, 9 and 14 are bright, the strongest layer 9 head 14 at 0.88. Right: weight on the first position, over queries that can see it; layers 0–7 are dark, layers 8–18 bright, the strongest layer 17 head 15 at 0.86.
